name: Under Contract
source:
Hell.

That's what Atticus thought he was living through.

How will his outlook on life change when meeting a self-proclaimed demon?

If only he remembered the terms of their contract...

[From [url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/under-contract]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
地狱。

阿提克斯一直以为，自己每天都在地狱里煎熬度日。

当他邂逅一位自称恶魔的家伙时，他的人生观将会发生怎样的改变？

要是他还记得两人契约上的条款就好了……

[摘自[url=https://jerichowo.itch.io/under-contract]itch.io[/url]]
